verdict.rationale: None of the evidence describes any mechanism for power-users to explicitly configure context-memory allocation (e.g., per-instance context window sizing, GPU/CPU memory partitioning) when running multiple concurrent models; the docs only mention running multiple models concurrently (ollama-docs-17) without any control knobs. Community evidence (ollama-comm-13) explicitly states Ollama 'hides all the server configs in favor of their own sane defaults' and doesn't even expose mlock control, reinforcing the lack of granular memory control.
